body: ac-00 (GATE, done): substrate gap found — adjudicated 0.68 NOT reproducible per-column (only raw panel labels persisted; the 8 panel-wrong flips never localised). DECISION: freeze at PANEL tier (repr-panel-sonnet, no author tier), advisory band on the DELTA (flag fires when candidate repr drops >CI ~6pp below v19). Advisory not blocking: n small + panel-tier ~3pp anti-model bias, but bias is common-mode so it cancels in the candidate-vs-v19 delta. Blocking gates (gold+corpus-honest) unchanged. Corrected ac-02: baseline is panel ~0.648 under reframe, not 0.68. Deliverable: output/representative-accuracy-gate/ac00_tier_and_band_policy.md.

ac-01 (done): froze eval/repr/representative_corpus.tsv (260 cols, gold schema) via scripts/build_representative_fixture.py from persisted study artifacts (panel_labels.json + repr_predictions.tsv); membership = the 2026-06-17 realised draw (draw script was ephemeral, so fixture IS canonical record, like gold). Provenance records panel tier + confidence. Leakage firewall STANDING: registered fixture in gold_anchor_guard.GOLD_CORPUS_FIXTURES (future training excludes it); make leakage-guard GREEN (0 overlap w/ training). Fixed test_gold_anchor_guard disjointness assertion to robust union form — surfaced that the random draw hit 1 gold-anchor column (Count_read); repr<->gold overlap = 1/260 (negligible).

ac-02 (done): v19 repr baseline = 0.691 reframe (CI 0.632-0.744, n=259); raw 0.610. Existing gold scorer reads fixture unchanged (no new code). Study's 0.648 RECONCILED: = 162/250 (10 artifacts dropped); fresh raw 0.610 differs by 23 intended prediction drifts 0.6.33->0.6.34 — ~16 categorical->word (enum-reframe rule retirement, invisible under --reframe) + ~6 Author full_name->username (veto correctly firing). Raw is unstable to Sharpen changes; reframe is the invariant gate lens. Deliverable: output/representative-accuracy-gate/ac02_baseline_and_reconciliation.md + reframe/raw reports.

ac-03 (done): added REPRESENTATIVE (advisory) band to promotion order in CLAUDE.md (after gold+scoreboard, before corpus-honest blocking gate) with full advisory rationale (n=260 CI ~6pp, panel-tier ~3pp bias common-mode -> delta is the signal, flag on drop>CI vs v19). Added quality-gate pointer to docs/RELEASE.md promotion flow. Blocking gates (gold+corpus-honest H05) unchanged.

ac-04 (GATE, done): scored v19 + s44(identity NO-GO) on BOTH instruments, reframe. v19 gold 0.797/repr 0.691; s44 gold 0.783(-1.4pp)/repr 0.683(-0.8pp). VERDICT outcome (b): repr TRACKS gold (both down), and is the WEAKER detector — s44's repr drop 0.008 is within the ±6pp CI so the advisory flag would NOT fire, while gold caught it (-13 cols). Mechanism: full_name broadening hits HARD boundary cols gold over-samples / repr under-samples. So DETECTION role unproven (no divergence on today's only NO-GO candidate; not manufactured). But LEVEL role PROVEN + is scenario 1's actual goal: standing 10pp gap (repr 0.691 vs gold 0.797), stable across both candidates. KEEP fixture for level reporting; hold advisory-flag detection as unproven; gold+corpus-honest stay blocking. Deliverable: output/representative-accuracy-gate/ac04_earns_its_keep.md.
